name: MemWyre
description: Personal Knowledge Base & Memory Layer for AI Agents. Save, search, and retrieve memories, documents, and contextual knowledge across any LLM.

authentication.description: Generate an API key from your MemWyre dashboard at https://memwyre.tech/dashboard/settings. Pass it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

tools.name: search_memwyre
tools.description: Semantic search across your saved memories, documents, and notes.

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Save a new memory snippet to your MemWyre Vault.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a specific document by ID.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: Get list of pending memories in the Inbox.

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Update the content of an existing memory.

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Delete a memory or document by ID.

tools.name: search_by_date
tools.description: Find memories created within a specific date range.

tools.name: get_all_tags
tools.description: Get a list of all tags used in your knowledge base.

tools.name: generate_prompt
tools.description: Generate a prompt with retrieved context from your memories.
